# sfcompute_orders (Data Source)

Reads orders from SF Compute (`GET /v2/orders`). All pages are fetched unless `limit`, `starting_after` or `ending_before` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sfcompute_orders" "standing" {
  status = ["standing"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `_preview_deployment` (String) Filter to one deployment's orders (ID or resource path). Without it, the list omits deployment-managed orders.
- `_preview_procurement` (String) Filter to one procurement's orders (ID or resource path). Without it, the list omits procurement orders.
- `created_after` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `created_before` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `ending_before` (String) Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the previous page.
- `id` (List of String) Filter by order ID (repeatable).
- `limit` (Number)
- `pool` (String) Filter by pool.
- `side` (String)
- `sort_by` (String) Prefix with `-` for descending.
- `starting_after` (String) Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the next page.
- `status` (List of String) Filter by status (repeatable).
- `workspace` (String) Scope the listing to a single workspace (ID, resource path, or name). Ignored when `pool` is given (the pool already names its workspace). Without either, the list spans the whole organization and requires an org-level `Order:List` grant. If omitted, the provider's `workspace` is used.

### Read-Only

- `cursor` (String) Pass as `starting_after` or `ending_before` to paginate.
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `_preview_preemption_limit_price_multiple` (String) **Preview.** Buy orders only. The multiple of `limit_price_dollars_per_node_hour` at which SF Compute lists this order's filled compute for sale. Omitted when unset.
- `allocation_schedule_delta` (Attributes List) Change in capacity if the order fills. Must be a single time range with both `start_at` and `end_at`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--allocation_schedule_delta))
- `allow_partial` (Boolean) If true, the order may fill partially — fewer nodes and/or a subset of the requested time window.
- `allow_standing` (Boolean) If true, the order stays in the order book until either fills, is explicitly cancelled, or the order end time is reached resulting in automatic cancellation. If false, the order is cancelled immediately if it doesn't fill.
- `cancelled_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `filled_allocation_schedule_delta` (Attributes List) The total portion of the requested schedule that has filled. Once `state` is `cancelled`, this is final and remains available on later get and list responses. Empty for orders with no fills; the unfilled remainder is `allocation_schedule_delta` minus this. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--filled_allocation_schedule_delta))
- `filled_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `fills` (Attributes List) Complete list of contracts produced by this order. Once `state` is `cancelled`, this list is final and remains available on later get and list responses. Omitted for orders with no fills. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--fills))
- `id` (String)
- `limit_price_dollars_per_node_hour` (String) Price in dollars per node-hour, encoded as a decimal string. Prices are rounded to the nearest $0.000060/node-hour market tick. This is one microdollar per node-minute. Responses contain the rounded value with six decimal places. Inputs must contain a decimal point, be non-negative, and not exceed $500/node-hour.
- `pool` (Attributes) Target pool that receives or loses compute if this order fills (depending on order type). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--pool))
- `side` (String)
- `sku` (Attributes) SKU this order is pinned to. Carries the SKU's human-readable name when one is registered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--sku))
- `state` (String) Current state of the order.
- `workspace` (Attributes) Workspace that owns the order's pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--workspace))

### Nested Schema for `data.fills`

Read-Only:

- `allocation_schedule_delta` (Attributes List) Capacity change this fill delivered. Quantities are always positive; `side` on the parent order determines whether this added or removed capacity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--fills--allocation_schedule_delta))
- `filled_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `price_dollars_per_node_hour` (String) Price in dollars per node-hour, encoded as a decimal string. Prices are rounded to the nearest $0.000060/node-hour market tick. This is one microdollar per node-minute. Responses contain the rounded value with six decimal places. Inputs must contain a decimal point, be non-negative, and not exceed $500/node-hour.
